question: Mauryan Empire in India was established in 322 B.C. with its capital in Pataliputra which is now known as _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Patna__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the fourth century BCE, the Magadha capital was shifted to Pataliputra, present-day Patna, Bihar, commanding routes of communication along the Ganga. 
 
• The growth of Magadha culminated in the emergence of the Mauryan Empire.
 
• Bimbisara was the first king of Magadha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Chandragupta Maurya, who founded the Mauryan empire (c. 321 BCE), extended control as far northwest as Afghanistan and Baluchistan, and his grandson Asoka, arguably the most famous ruler of early India, conquered Kalinga (present-day coastal Orissa).
 
• Rajagriha was the capital of Magadha during Bimbisara’s time. 
 
• The three great rules of the Mauryan Empire were
 
 
• Chandragupta Maurya, Bindusara, and king Ashoka.
